up: Return the exact activity values and structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614544. Include the following columns in the output: the compound's ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles), activity standard type (standard_type), standard relation (standard_relation), standard value (standard_value), and standard units (standard_units).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614544'
